name: GPQA Diamond
description: 198 graduate-level, Google-proof science questions (biology, physics, chemistry) written and validated by PhD experts.
human_baseline_note: PhD-level domain experts scored 69.7% (Rein et al. 2023, Diamond subset).

name: SWE-bench Verified
description: 500 human-validated real GitHub issues; the model must produce a patch that passes the repository tests.
preferred_config: lab-reported default scaffold, pass@1 (no parallel test-time compute)

name: AIME (American Invitational Mathematics Examination)
description: 30 competition math problems per year with integer answers; labs report the most recent edition (2024 or 2025). Edition recorded in config.
preferred_config: AIME 2025 without tools; fall back to AIME 2024 for models from 2024
human_baseline_note: Top ~5% of US high-school contestants qualify; a median qualifier scores roughly 5/15 per exam.

name: MMLU-Pro
description: 12k harder multiple-choice questions (10 options) across 14 domains; reasoning-heavy successor to MMLU.

name: Humanity's Last Exam
description: 2,500 expert-written questions across 100+ subjects designed to sit at the frontier of human knowledge.
preferred_config: no tools, full set (text + multimodal); record 'text-only' or 'with tools' in config when that is all a lab reports
human_baseline_note: Each question is solvable by its expert author; no aggregate human score exists.

name: ARC-AGI-2
description: Novel visual abstraction puzzles that humans solve easily and that resist memorisation; measures fluid intelligence.
preferred_config: semi-private evaluation set (ARC Prize verified); public eval if that is all a lab reports
human_baseline_note: Every task was solved by at least two humans in controlled testing; the average test-taker panel scored about 60%.

name: Terminal-Bench 2.0
description: 89 hard, verified real-world terminal tasks (compilation, ops, data wrangling) solved end-to-end by an agent in a sandbox.
preferred_config: Terminus-2 harness or lab default; version 2.0 only (1.0 is a different benchmark)

name: τ²-bench
description: Agentic customer-service simulations (retail, airline, telecom) where the model must follow policy while using tools and talking to a simulated user.
preferred_config: pass^1 average across domains; if only per-domain numbers exist, record the unweighted mean and list domains in note

name: MMMU
description: 11.5k college-level multimodal questions spanning 30 subjects; requires reading diagrams, charts and images.
preferred_config: validation split, original MMMU (record 'MMMU-Pro' in config when that is what a lab reports)
human_baseline_note: Human experts scored 88.6% on the validation set (Yue et al. 2023).

name: LiveCodeBench
description: Continuously refreshed competitive-programming problems collected after model training cut-offs to resist contamination.
preferred_config: pass@1; record the problem window/version (e.g. v6) in config

name: MMLU
description: 57-subject multiple-choice knowledge test; saturated since 2024 but anchors the 2023–2024 generation.

name: HumanEval
description: 164 hand-written Python programming problems checked by unit tests; saturated, kept as a legacy anchor.

name: MATH (Hendrycks)
description: 12.5k competition mathematics problems; saturated by 2025, kept as a legacy anchor (MATH-500 accepted, noted in config).
preferred_config: full test set or MATH-500 (record which)
human_baseline_note: A three-time IMO gold medalist scored 90% on a sample (Hendrycks et al. 2021).

name: GSM8K
description: 8.5k grade-school math word problems; saturated since 2024 but links the 2021–2024 generations of every lab.

name: HellaSwag
description: Adversarially filtered commonsense sentence completion; saturated since 2023, anchors the 2019–2023 generations (GPT-3, PaLM, LLaMA).

name: ARC Challenge
description: Grade-school science questions that retrieval and co-occurrence methods fail (Challenge set); saturated since 2023.

name: WinoGrande
description: Large-scale Winograd-schema pronoun resolution with adversarial filtering; saturated since 2023.

name: LAMBADA
description: Last-word prediction on narrative passages that need the whole context; the one benchmark GPT-2, GPT-3, PaLM and GLM-130B all reported.

name: SWE-bench Pro
description: Harder, contamination-resistant successor to SWE-bench Verified (Scale AI). Recorded, not yet in the index (too few labs report it).

name: BrowseComp
description: 1,266 hard-to-find facts that require persistent multi-step web browsing to locate. Recorded, not in the index.
human_baseline_note: Human trainers solved 29.2% of problems within a 2-hour limit.

name: OSWorld / OSWorld-Verified
description: 369 real computer-use tasks across operating systems and applications executed by an agent. Recorded, not in the index.
preferred_config: OSWorld-Verified, record step budget in config

name: FrontierMath
description: Unpublished research-level mathematics problems evaluated by Epoch AI. Usually reported by the maintainer, not labs. Recorded, not in the index.
